header.description: What: an enemy anti-personnel minefield 'Field A' (20 x 20 m, mines every 4 m) lies on test-town's open ground at (120-140, 70-90); Friend does not know it. A Friend 'Engineer' 25 m west at (95, 80) is ordered to ReconMinefield toward the field's centre (130, 80) at detector pace (0.3 m/s). He probes one 10 m cell at a time; the first mined cell starts a left-hand trace round the field on cells he has swept clear, and closing it MARKS the field for Friend (CE-4624 MS-B2, Minefields MF-13, MR-7). Judge: (1) the Engineer runs ReconMinefield; (2) Friend knows the field's mined cells; (3) Friend has the field MARKED; (4) he never steps into the field (never within 10 m of its centre); (5) no mine goes off and he is never hurt. Fail: a blast, a hurt engineer, or no mark by the end. Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh mf-recon-and-mark
